info.name: Permit.io Access Requests (EAP) Access Requests (EAP) Condition Set Rules API

params.name: proj_id
params.description: Either the unique id of the project, or the URL-friendly key of the project (i.e: the "slug").

params.name: env_id
params.description: Either the unique id of the environment, or the URL-friendly key of the environment (i.e: the "slug").

params.name: user_set
params.description: optional user set filter, will only return rules where the permission is granted to this user set

params.name: permission
params.description: optional permission filter, will only return condition set rules granting this permission

params.name: resource_set
params.description: optional resource set filter, will only return rules where the permission is granted on this resource set

params.name: page
params.description: Page number of the results to fetch, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: The number of results per page (max 100).

items.docs:
Lists the condition set rules matching the filter.
- If the `user_set` filter is present, will only return the permissions set of that user set.
- If the `permission` filter is present, will only return the permissions sets that equals to the queried permission.
- If the `resource_set` filter is present, will only return the permissions set of that resource set.
